answers: design finding 1: done** — DSCLA-12 evidence is now on the same line as the SPEC: `DSCLA-12[done]: ... evidence: scripts/lib/run-status-render.sh | rsc_finalize_body() {`. Removed the separate indented evidence line.

design finding 2: done** — The design no longer creates `core/claim/claim.sh` as a new owner. The first step now amends `plugins/claim-coordinator/github-labels/plugin.sh` to change `claim_coordinator_claim` and `claim_coordinator_release` to implement the new behavior (zbuild:claimed label, holder extraction). `core/claim/claim.sh` is now a thin wiring bridge that sources the plugin and delegates to its public functions — no private `_ccgl_*` calls.
